Moves the points of a las file by the given distances along the three axes, in the units of its reference system.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › utilities<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** las, move<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.utilities.LasMover`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFile` | LAS file |  |  | The las file to move. |
| `pDeltaX` | double |  | `0` | The easting translation to apply. |
| `pDeltaY` | double |  | `0` | The northing translation to apply. |
| `pDeltaZ` | double |  | `0` | The elevation translation to apply. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFile` | output file |  | The moved las file. |
